title: Live fast-path wire-cue append (exec.odin commit_draw) has ZERO test coverage — deleting it passes all CI gates
detail: The shipped game's wire click depends solely on this append. No unit test, parity scenario (nil by design), or golden (drives step, never exec) observes it — a revert-style delete ships green, exactly this project's r5 'wiring unpinned' blocker class.
recommended_fix: Add an exec-level test (settings_effect_wiring precedent): construct Input with sim_events + log buffers, drive commit_draw, assert one PIPE_DRAWN at tick+1 on valid draw and none on invalid.

title: New core emissions (PIPE_DRAWN, NODE_SPAWNED) pinned only via T1 golden hashes — no core unit tests, breaching the pin-invariants-in-core convention
evidence:
core/step.odin:86 + 123:
					event_emit(state, tick, EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN)
...
			event_emit(state, tick, EVENT_TAG_NODE_SPAWNED)
grep of core/*_test.odin: zero references to tags 15/16 (core/growth_test.odin: 0 EVENT_TAG matches), while 10 test files pin prior tags (crisis_test 32, health_test 36, win_lose_test 25, era_test 6...).
detail: Project rule: 'Pin every design invariant as a regression test at the lowest layer (core/)'. T1 hashes bite on any change but localize nothing; the negative legs (no event on rejected command, no spawn when growth off) lack named assertions.
recommended_fix: Add core tests: successful Cmd_Draw_Pipe at apply tick emits exactly one PIPE_DRAWN; a failing command emits none; growth tick with intent.spawn emits NODE_SPAWNED, growth-off emits none.

title: Immediacy acceptance criterion (~50 ms) has no automated verification — by-construction argument only
evidence:
Spec briefing line 29 (acceptance):
- Latency/immediacy verified (sound within ~50 ms of event).
_pr_body.md (by-construction claim, no test artifact):
- **Wire placed:** the event is appended at input time; the consumer drains `events[audio_mark:]` once per frame → ≤ 1 frame (~16.7 ms @ 60 fps) from gesture to `PlaySound`.
detail: An explicit acceptance criterion ships with no pinning test; the main-loop ordering (step → drain events[audio_mark:] → flush) is unpinned app wiring, same class as the exec gap.
recommended_fix: Pin the drain ordering as a seam test, or record the criterion as by-construction-reviewed in the PR with reviewer sign-off.

title: Device-gated flush/play legs for wire+spawn untested; deleting the new flush loops passes CI, and the header's cited 'app smoke check' exists nowhere
detail: Harness vacuous guards count consume-side draws only, so removing the wire/spawn PlaySound loops ships green. Consistent with the 7.2 convention for crisis/arrival, but the referenced smoke check is absent.
recommended_fix: Extract the pure batch computation (variant cycling per kind) from audio_flush and unit-test it; add the smoke check to CI or drop the claim.

title: Test-surface comments claim 'ALL FOUR kinds' fire in audio.dem, contradicting the actual guard set and audio.dem's growth-off recipe
detail: audio.dem (growth off) cannot fire NODE_SPAWNED; both comments self-contradict, misleading future maintainers about what each golden proves and where spawn coverage lives.
recommended_fix: Rewrite both comments: audio.dem proves three kinds (crisis+arrival+wire); audio_spawn.dem proves spawn+wire. Delete the 'ALL FOUR' phrasing.
